svg.title: Gluu: Cross App Access, end to end
svg.desc: Bob signs in with a passkey at S&V's Gluu; S&V's Keycloak keeps his Gluu tokens. His agent calls Ledgerline through S&V's egress gateway with only his S&V access token. The egress gets his Gluu ID token, S&V's Gluu issues an ID-JAG, the egress checks it, Ledgerline's Gluu redeems it for a Ledgerline token, and Ledgerline answers as its own account for Bob.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Gluu · Cross App Access, end to end

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Bob signs in with a passkey at S&V's Gluu. His agent reaches Ledgerline as him: S&V's Gluu vouches (ID-JAG), Ledgerline's Gluu redeems it.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: The agent only ever holds Bob's S&V access token. Gluu unreachable: S&V's Keycloak vouches instead. Gluu refuses: the call is refused.
